_comum: This image shows a blank blue plastic mannequin used by a game character dress-up system. Put ONLY this one item on the mannequin: {item} Everything that the item does not cover must stay exactly the same blank smooth blue plastic mannequin: no face, no hair, no skin, no other clothing or accessories. Paint the item in a clean hand-painted stylized fantasy game art style with soft shading and dark outlines. Keep exactly the same mannequin proportions, the same pose with both arms stretched out to the sides, the same size and position in the frame and the same plain light background. Flat even lighting, no cast shadows.
Peitoral: a dark fantasy knight's steel cuirass: polished steel breastplate and backplate with gold trim, a steel gorget collar around the base of the neck, large rounded steel pauldrons on both shoulders, chainmail sleeves with steel vambraces on the arms ending at the wrists, and steel tassets hanging from the waist over a short dark red pleated cloth skirt that ends above the knees. The head, hands, lower legs and feet stay bare blue mannequin: no leg armor, no boots.
Elmo: an open-faced steel knight's helmet with gold trim, cheek guards and a small gold crest on top, covering the top, back and sides of the head and leaving the blank blue face area open and visible. The whole body below the neck stays bare blue mannequin.
Manoplas: a pair of medieval steel gauntlets worn on both hands like metal gloves: articulated steel plates covering every finger, the back of each hand and the wrist, with a short flared steel cuff and gold trim. Both hands must be completely covered in steel. The forearms, upper arms, head, torso, legs and feet stay bare blue mannequin.
Grevas: steel plate armor ONLY on the two legs: steel cuisses covering the thighs, rounded knee guards with gold trim, steel greaves covering the shins and steel sabatons covering the feet completely. Nothing at all on the upper body: the head, arms, hands, chest, belly and hips stay bare blue mannequin, with no breastplate, no pauldrons, no skirt and no belt.
Tunica: a sleeveless sage green padded tunic with a standing collar, a wide brown leather belt with a brass ring buckle at the waist, and a skirt part that reaches the top of the thighs. The head, the whole arms, the hands, the legs and the feet stay bare blue mannequin.
Calca: a pair of dark brown cloth trousers, fitted at the hips with a visible waistband just below the navel, slightly baggy at the knees and ending at the ankles. The head, torso, arms, hands and feet stay bare blue mannequin.
Luvas: a pair of brown leather gloves worn on both hands: soft brown leather covering every finger, the palms and the backs of the hands completely, with wide flared leather cuffs trimmed in gold around the wrists. Both hands must be completely covered in leather, with no blue fingers visible. The forearms, upper arms, head, torso, legs and feet stay bare blue mannequin.
Botas: a pair of heavy brown leather boots with thick soles and folded cuffs with a gold trim, reaching halfway up the shins. The head, arms, torso and legs above the boots stay bare blue mannequin.
Cabelo: a short messy layered auburn red hairstyle with volume and a side-swept fringe, like a wig placed on the mannequin's head, covering the top, back and sides of the head but leaving the blank blue face area visible. The whole body below the neck stays bare blue mannequin.
